name: WinStar World Casino
desc: Casino resort in Thackerville, Oklahoma, owned and operated by the Chickasaw Nation, with 370,000 sq ft of gaming floor and about 1,495 rooms.
products: Casino gaming (10,000+ electronic games, 100 table games, 55-table poker room), hotel, dining, entertainment
customers: Visitors mainly from the Dallas-Fort Worth and Oklahoma region
stores_or_sites: one main resort plus The Inn at WinStar
markets: United States: Oklahoma and North Texas (about an hour north of Dallas-Fort Worth)

alt_indicators.evidence: largest US casino by gaming floor space after 2013 expansion; 370,000 sq ft, 10,000+ electronic games, about 1,495 hotel rooms

fit_rationale: Regional destination casino drawing Dallas-Fort Worth visitors; a US race tie-in (Austin) could suit promotions, but its catchment is regional and tribal gaming marketing is usually local.
category_conflict: potential: casino/gaming partners exist at some teams; verify

access.roles: Chickasaw Nation Department of Commerce gaming leadership, VP Marketing WinStar

outstanding: Revenue or third-party estimate, employees, sponsorships; Chickasaw Nation commerce structure; second independent scale indicator
